claims.claim: American drive Gearbox for Ford Econoline E150 E250 E350 V8
claims.evidence: Witness only reports a car engine/transmission assembly with wiring/hoses; make/model/variant and Ford Econoline V8 compatibility are not readable in the provided observations.
No documentation, markings, or origin proof is shown in the witness observations.
Witness photos show the assembly visually, but no start-up video, compression test, fault-code scan, or running test is reported.
No audio/video of engine running is included in the witness observations.
Mileage/usage history is explicitly not shown/readable in the witness report.
Photos do not confirm whether the engine/gearbox has been opened; witness notes some parts look dirty and possibly missing covers/fasteners, which does not prove opening status.

risks.risk: Wrong fitment/compatibility (Econoline E150/E250/E350 V8, and correct gearbox type/ratios) cannot be confirmed from the photos.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the gearbox identification plate/part number and engine/gearbox casting numbers (plus a photo showing the exact vehicle application label if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used engine/transmission assembly with unknown fitment and unknown gearbox type.

risks.risk: Not actually tested/working (internal damage, worn bearings, bad sensors, or transmission issues) since no running/compression/fault-code evidence is shown.
risks.proof: Video of cold start and idle + a scan tool screenshot showing no active fault codes (or fault codes if any) and a short drive/gear engagement video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: may be faulty) and treat as parts/repair risk.

risks.risk: Missing parts/covers/fasteners or incomplete assembly (witness notes possibly missing covers/fasteners).
risks.proof: Full 360° walkaround video showing all components present, including any ECU, starter, alternator, sensors, and all harness connectors; close-ups of any exposed mounting points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness until all missing items are confirmed.

risks.risk: Leakage or seal/gasket failure (oil/coolant) not verifiable from dusty/grimy appearance alone.
risks.proof: Photos of underside and mating surfaces with clean wipe-down marks, plus a leak check video after running (or pressure test results).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential leak risk (worst-case: seals/gaskets may need replacement).

risks.risk: Damage not visible in the angles provided (cracks, bent components, corrosion, or impact damage).
risks.proof: High-resolution close-ups of critical areas: bellhousing, mounting brackets, oil pan area, coolant passages, and any casting seams; plus a straight-on shot of the engine block and transmission casing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with unknown condition beyond visible grime.

risks.risk: Matching risk: cannot verify engine number/VIN matching to a specific vehicle or to the claimed application.
risks.proof: Clear photo of engine number/serial plate and gearbox serial/part number (readable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as unverified matching (fitment and provenance uncertain).

proof_requests: Send clear, readable photos of the gearbox identification plate/part number and any casting numbers.
Send clear, readable photos of engine serial/engine number (and gearbox serial) for matching.
Provide a video of the engine starting and running (audio included) showing no abnormal knocks and stable idle.
Provide a scan tool screenshot showing fault codes status (and any live data if available).
Provide a short video showing transmission engagement/shifting (all gears) after start.
Provide photos/videos of underside and mating surfaces after wiping to check for oil/coolant leaks.
Provide a full 360° walkaround video confirming completeness of accessories (ECU, alternator, starter, sensors) and all harness connectors.
response.reason: The witness confirms an engine/transmission assembly exists, but key details needed to price it safely (exact model/fitment, working proof, completeness, and matching identifiers) are not readable or shown. Without those, any price would be guesswork.
